name: Gyromast's Revenge
summary: Along Darkshore, Gelkak Gyromast seeks revenge on the murlocs who plundered his wrecked ship. He sends you to wind up his mechanical first mate, the Threshwackonator 4100.

sections.title: A Captain's Vendetta
sections.body: Gelkak Gyromast is stranded on Darkshore, but he will not yield to the murlocs along the shore. He has gathered the parts for his plan and seeks revenge on their tribe and its chief. Rather than wade into the surf with his cutlass, the eccentric captain turns to engineering. He gives you a winding key and asks you to tend to his mechanical subordinate.

sections.title: The First Mate's Mutiny
sections.body: Gelkak's first mate is the Threshwackonator 4100, a clanking mechanical golem left in the shallows south of the wreck. The machine promises an easy slaughter of the murlocs, but it cannot be trusted. You wind it up and lead it back to Gelkak. Then it malfunctions and mistakes its rescuer and creator for hostile targets, forcing a battle on the beach.

faq.answer: Gelkak's first mate is the Threshwackonator 4100, an automated mechanical golem on the coast south of his stranded camp.

Gelkak's ship was wrecked along Darkshore. The native Greymist murlocs rummaged through the wreckage and took part of his first mate's key. He means to use the golem against their tribe and its chief.

faq.q: What happens when you bring the Threshwackonator back?
faq.answer: Use Gelkak's key to activate the Threshwackonator, then lead it back to him. What happens when it reaches the captain becomes clear during the escort.

faq.q: What do I do with Gyromast's Key after finishing the quest?
faq.answer: Gyromast's Key activates the Threshwackonator. Once the work is done, the key has no further purpose.

faq.q: Where did Gelkak get the Threshwackonator?
faq.answer: The Threshwackonator came with cargo and equipment salvaged from Gelkak's ill-fated voyage along northern Kalimdor. It was designed to give his crew heavy mechanical muscle.

faq.q: Does Gelkak give up after the golem is destroyed?
faq.answer: Gelkak's plans and response become clear when you bring his first mate back.

angles.text: Gelkak's mechanical first mate shows how much a stranded captain relies on engineering equipment.
As a gnome, you may recognize the winding key as a familiar way to activate a mechanical automaton.
As an Alliance traveler, you help clear malfunctioning machinery and aggressive murlocs from the coastline between Auberdine and the lands to the south.
